normalization.coupling: selected rows for one family/volume/ZA divided by that key's realized decay triggers
normalization.production: sum(RP)/sum(TT) separately within S3d_O8 x BUILDUP x family; zero-RP DAT TT already retained by authority
normalization.source_mix_reweight: full inventory Bq multiplied by selected/realized-trigger coupling

scope: S3d-O8 official full Step05-selected day-15 delayed W2 lineage
source_mix_warning: Observed weighted W2 contributions follow the realized 250k-trigger source mix. Use selected/realized-trigger coupling and full inventory Bq for source-mix-corrected screening; do not call observed_rate/full_Bq a decay coupling when mix ratios differ.
